import json,re,sys
from collections import Counter
from src.tools import merge_pair_v2 as merge
from src.tools import t01v2_look_funnel as funnel
from src.tools import t01v2_live_progress as live
from src.tools.t01v2_flip_review_checkpoint import source_support
from src.tools.t01v2_posthoc_solvability import verified_passed_rows
from src.envs import pair_v2_flip_policy as policy
from src.envs import pair_v2_fixed_labels as labels
from src.envs.pair_v2_flip_search import AttemptQuota
source="results/pilot_pairs_v2_flip60_fp204_r01_retry1_j707668_hopper_m_02_g0_floorplan204.json"
if len(sys.argv)!=1: raise ValueError("This explicit sealed-unit diagnostic accepts no substitute source")
with source_support():
 data,reference=merge.load_source(merge.ROOT/source)
 cfg,meta,metrics=data["config"],data["_meta"],data["metrics"]
 policy.validate_source(cfg,metrics)
 if (not meta.get("end") or type(meta.get("exit_code")) is not int
     or metrics.get("final_metrics_verified") is not True
     or metrics.get("terminal_verified_after_cleanup") is not True
     or metrics.get("terminal_finalization_error") is not None or not metrics.get("terminal_receipt")):
  raise ValueError("Require the original ended and sealed source, including failed/incomplete terminal status")
 expected=live.expected_identity(cfg["name"]); live.check_expected_shard(expected,cfg["shard"])
 if cfg["scene"]!="FloorPlan204" or cfg["shard"]["pbs_jobid"]!="707668.hopper-m-02":
  raise ValueError("Wrong explicit scene/job")
 eligibility,journal_ref,_=verified_passed_rows(data)
 if journal_ref is None: raise ValueError("Sealed unit requires its authenticated complete journal")
 path=merge.reference_path(journal_ref,within=merge.ROOT/"data/world_pairs/v2")
 complete=path.read_bytes()
 if complete and not complete.endswith(b"\n"): raise ValueError("Sealed journal ends with an incomplete line")
 counts=live.observed_counts(complete,cfg["scene"])
 rows=[]; measured=AttemptQuota()
 for line in complete.decode("utf-8").splitlines():
  if not line.strip(): continue
  journal=json.loads(line)
  raw_path=merge.reference_path(journal["raw_attempt"],within=cfg["raw_evidence_dir"])
  if raw_path.name!="attempt.json" or re.fullmatch(re.escape(journal["pair_id"])+r"_trial[0-9]{6}",raw_path.parent.name) is None:
   raise ValueError("Raw path does not bind this explicit pair/trial identity")
  raw=merge.read_reference(journal["raw_attempt"],within=cfg["raw_evidence_dir"])
  if any(raw.get(key)!=journal.get(key) for key in ("pair_id","scene","kind","status","discard_reasons","generation_seconds","pair_file","pair_sha256")):
   raise ValueError("Journal differs from the authenticated raw attempt")
  if raw.get("proposed_pool",journal.get("proposed_pool"))!="look" or raw.get("counts_as_pair_attempt") is not True:
   raise ValueError("New-source journal does not bind an actual counted Look attempt")
  labels.validate_fields(raw)
  for world in ("w0","w1"):
   reported=journal.get(world+"_valid_physical")
   actual=(raw.get("physical_"+world) or (raw.get("physical_key_numbers") or {}).get("physical_"+world) or {}).get("valid_physical")
   if type(reported) is bool and reported is not actual: raise ValueError("Journal/raw physical result differs")
  if raw.get("identities",{}).get("anchor_type") not in (None,journal.get("anchor_type")):
   raise ValueError("Authenticated raw/journal anchor type differs")
  measured.record(raw_path,raw)
  rows.append({**raw,"anchor_type":journal.get("anchor_type"),"source_file":reference["file"],"raw_attempt":journal["raw_attempt"]})
 quota=measured.summary()
 if metrics.get("measured_flip_attempt_quota")!=quota:
  raise ValueError("Final scene-wide quota differs from the authenticated complete journal")
 reasons=Counter(reason for row in rows for reason in row["discard_reasons"])
 report={"source":reference,"scene":cfg["scene"],"field_of_view":cfg["field_of_view"],"job_id":cfg["shard"]["pbs_jobid"],
  "fixed_label_version":cfg["fixed_label_version"],"start":meta["start"],"end":meta["end"],"duration_sec":meta["duration_sec"],
  "exit_code":meta["exit_code"],"status":metrics["status"],"error":metrics.get("error"),"cleanup_errors":metrics.get("cleanup_errors"),
  "collection_completed":metrics["status"] in ("completed_search","completed_quota"),
  "sealed_terminal":True,"source_eligibility":eligibility,"journal":journal_ref,
  "source_attempts":metrics["attempts"],"source_reported_passed_by_class":metrics["passed_by_class"],
  "verified_actual_quota":quota,"observed_counts":counts,"discard_reason_counts":dict(reasons),
  "native_placement_failures_not_counted":metrics.get("placement_exhausted_proposals"),
  "groups":[{"mode":mode,"funnel":funnel.summarize([row for row in rows if row["mode"]==mode])} for mode in ("flip","stay")],
  "by_anchor":[{"anchor_type":anchor,"mode":mode,"funnel":funnel.summarize([row for row in rows if row["anchor_type"]==anchor and row["mode"]==mode])}
    for anchor in sorted({row["anchor_type"] for row in rows},key=lambda value:"" if value is None else value) for mode in ("flip","stay")],
  "scope":"Complete authenticated terminal journal, including incomplete/failed collection; original funnel.summarize. This diagnostic is not independent pair acceptance.",
  "unknown_policy":"Unreached or unrecorded gates remain unknown; no missing measurement is changed to zero.",
  "thresholds_changed":False,"source_artifacts_modified":False}
 print("SEALED_FLIP_ANCHOR_FUNNEL_JSON: "+json.dumps(report,sort_keys=True,allow_nan=False),flush=True)
